The delivering lane flagged it rather than claiming it pre-existing, which was right, and I could not attribute it either without a build at an older commit. CANDIDATES, in order: (1) BL-1335 taxes, merged the day before, now charge a share of operating profit every quarter the fixture steps - though the tax is floored at 0 so a loss-making fixture corp should pay nothing, which is the first thing to check; (2) the construction rate work changed what a build charges per tick; (3) market prices moved under the fixture so the base simply costs more. NOT a defect in the road or grid work: construction_progress (910), tile_card (71) and roads (31) all pass on the same build with zero failures. THE WORK: find which, then either fix the cause or fund the fixture honestly - never by widening the loop count, which would hide a real cost change. CORRECTED 2026-10-18, and MY FILED PREMISE WAS WRONG. The refusal is not affordability: once verify_api stopped collapsing refusals into 'failed' (see below), the message reads 'fixture could not place a military base near the player's works: needs_road' (lib.lua:249). BL-1452.author: main session (Ben land battle form 2026-10-29)
BL-1452.title: Carried supplies: food, ammunition and equipment stocks per unit; hunger, starvation and proportional shortage
BL-1452.design: Written in MILITARY.md § Carried supplies (Ben, 2026-10-29). Three stored per-mille stocks per unit, drained daily (food by ration, ammunition per day fighting, equipment by battle loss and attrition), resupplied daily at the quarterly LP share x daily need. Food below full: flat -15% attack and readiness recovery. Food at zero: HP loses full establishment over 180 days linearly, readiness capped at HP share. Ammunition and equipment each scale every combat stat proportionally; ammunition floored at 20%, equipment unfloored; they multiply with morale. The round reads the stocks, not supply_factor_permille directly. Save fields; a harness; first-cut rates authored in economy.lua. Needs BL-1445 (move by days) for the daily cadence and the quarterly supply share. DELIVERED 2026-10-30 at the sprint 60 close (v0.2.4); Ben's live clicks passed.

BL-1453.author: main session (Ben land battle form 2026-10-29)
BL-1453.title: Land recon and stealth: hits scale by the visible share of the target
BL-1453.design: Written in MILITARY.md § Recon (Ben, 2026-10-29). Visible share = min(1, side recon / target stealth), every hit on that target scaled by it. Two-way, no floor, defender recon x1.5. Side recon = kit recon of its fighting units + its own units adjacent to the defended tile + target stealth x min(1, days/20) + every own wing active over the province (recon class most, others a base amount) + superiority share. Recon and stealth become kit stat deltas; base stealth per class; better infantry armour raises stealth. Air hook needs BL-1449 (air combat core). Harness cases: zero recon lands nothing, day 20 full vision, defender advantage, adjacency, air. DELIVERED 2026-10-30 at the sprint 60 close (v0.2.4); Ben's live clicks passed.

BL-1455.author: main session (Ben terrain modifier form 2026-10-29)
BL-1455.title: Terrain and the classes: per-class terrain rows - blocked unless roaded, march multiplier, fight debuff, equipment wear, terrain stealth
BL-1455.design: Written in MILITARY.md § Terrain and the classes (Ben, 2026-10-29). Per land class x terrain (mountain, canyon/rift landforms; marsh, desert=dunes, forest, urban, snow covers) up to four effects: move multiplier on march days; blocked unless the tile has a road (refuses entry, never exit); fight scale on soft/hard attack, defence and breakthrough when the defended tile is that terrain, each unit by its own class, halved by a road on the defended tile; equipment wear (faster daily equipment drain, the carried-supplies stock). Motorised/mechanised infantry dismount to foot pace on mountain/canyon/rift. Medium armour blocked in desert unless roaded, -30% there. Worst row only when a tile matches two. Stealth: infantry x1.5 in forest/urban; open ground (plains/highland with no concealing cover) x0.75 for every unit. Authored rows in economy.military beside the march days, loader-checked. A block is a per-class wall in march_path: orders route around it or are refused with the reason; a retreat never steps onto a tile its class cannot enter. Wear lands on BL-1452 (carried supplies) and stealth on BL-1453 (land recon): it composes with whichever is merged first and owes the other its hook at merge. A harness; ACTIONS.json march preconditions name the refusal. DELIVERED 2026-10-30 at the sprint 60 close (v0.2.4); Ben's live clicks passed.

BL-1456.author: main session (Ben, 2026-10-29)
BL-1456.title: A unit draws off the road up to 8 tiles, paid at the closest road per item resupplied; the Logistics lens dashes the off-road leg
BL-1456.design: Written in LOGISTICS.md § A unit draws off the road (Ben, 2026-10-29) and LENSES.md § Logistics lens (dashed line). A unit's quarterly supply request is scored at the closest road tile of its nation's network within 8 steps over crossable land (ties lowest tile id), served by that tile's routed cover; the request is the quantity of goods its resupply needs. More than 8 tiles from any road: draws nothing. The lens draws, for each player unit off its network, a dashed line from the paying road tile to the unit, coloured on the road ramp by its granted/requested; beyond 8 tiles, red to the nearest reached road. MILITARY.md § Carried supplies and § Upkeep carry the cross-references. DELIVERED 2026-10-30 at the sprint 60 close (v0.2.4); Ben's live clicks passed.
